More discussion

Open question 1 · opinion

What would you notice first in an old-house cafe: the wood, the light.

Follow up: Use one detail from the lesson, then add your own opinion.

Open question 2 · personal_experience

Have you visited a cafe that felt connected to its town or region?

Follow up: Think about food, design, people, music, or the view.

Open question 3 · analysis

How do old buildings and modern coffee work together in this lesson?

Follow up: Explain one thing the old building gives and one thing the coffee.

Open question 4 · analysis

Why does local fruit help a cafe tell a story about Yamanashi?

Follow up: Use peaches, grapes, seasons, or nearby farms in your answer.
